title: TRIZ registry/operator mappings
tests_run: post-integration: python -m pytest tests/intelligence/test_triz.py tests/intelligence/test_invention_taxonomy.py tests/intelligence/test_contracts.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
tests_passed: 35 passed: post-integration TRIZ, invention, and contract tests
verified_facts: The registry contains exactly 40 immutable principles numbered 1..40 with unique numbers, stable ascending order across calls, and non-empty name/description.
Every returned TrizPrinciple carries technique_id T057; invalid lookups raise KeyError instead of returning a substitute.
CONTRADICTION_MATRIX_AVAILABLE is explicitly False: no 39x39 contradiction matrix is implemented, embedded or simulated.
limits: A principle in this registry is a reasoning prompt only: listing it does NOT demonstrate that any derived proposal is feasible, novel or patentable.
The 39x39 contradiction matrix is not included because no sourced, licensed numeric dataset is available in this repo; fabricating one is prohibited by the task.
Principle names follow the widely published canonical list; short descriptions are paraphrases written for this registry, not verbatim quotes from any single licensed source.
decisions: triz.py declares module-level TRIZ_TECHNIQUE_ID='T057' matching taxonomy.py operator 'triz'; __init__.py and registry.py were NOT touched per task constraints.
Dataclass is frozen with __post_init__ validation (range 1..40, non-empty fields) so malformed entries cannot be constructed silently.
Post-integration hardening rejects any constructed TrizPrinciple whose technique_id is not T057, preserving the every-result traceability contract.
CONTRADICTION_MATRIX_AVAILABLE=False is exposed for consumers instead of any partial or invented matrix.
risks: Without wiring in invention/__init__.py or registry handlers, T057 is declared in taxonomy but not yet executable through OperatorRegistry; that wiring belongs to a later integration task.
follow_up: Integration task may register a 'triz' OperatorHandler and export symbols from invention/__init__.py once the shared-file conflict with P09-T06 is resolved.
